meta.description: Token/latency benchmark. Measures actual token consumption, throughput, and wall-clock latency across 3 tiers.
meta.hypothesis: MEDIUM tier (flash) has 3-5x lower latency than BRAIN. CHEAP has highest tok/sec. Token throughput scales inversely with capability.
meta.methodology: Each scenario is a standalone prompt. Runner measures wall-clock time, estimates token counts from response length (1 tok ~= 4 chars), and records pricing estimates.

scenarios.prompt: What is the difference between TCP and UDP? Answer in 2-3 sentences.
Explain how a distributed consensus algorithm like Raft works. Include leader election, log replication, and safety properties. Write ~500 words.
Implement a complete LRU cache in TypeScript with generics, O(1) get/put, expiration TTL, event emitter for evictions, and comprehensive error handling. Include JSDoc. Write ~200 lines.
Calculate the sum of all prime numbers between 1 and 100. Show your work in 2-3 lines.
Design the architecture for a real-time collaborative document editor (like Google Docs). Cover: OT vs CRDT, WebSocket mesh, persistence layer, conflict resolution, cursor sync. ~500 words.

Design a complete REST API for a multi-tenant SaaS platform. Include: authentication via JWT, RBAC with 3 roles, CRUD for 4 entities, rate limiting, pagination, soft delete, audit logging, and webhook support. Write a complete OpenAPI 3.0 spec in YAML.
